Link your council account

Sign in once with your City of Stonnington ePermits details. p.stonn keeps an encrypted session so it can update your permit for you.

Your ePermits account must use this same email — it can’t be changed here. If your council account uses a different address, sign out and sign back in with that one. And if someone else in your household manages the permit, there’s nothing to link here — they can invite you from Settings → Shared access on their account, so you never need their council password.

Forgot it — or never set one? Reset it at the council, then link here.
